bugs.summary: update.packages() reinstalls same version of package in some cases
bugs.creator: kevinushey

comments.creator: kevinushey
comments.text:
This seems to occur if the source version and the binary version of the package on CRAN differ. Currently, this is true for isoband. Using this R script, in a new session:

```
.libPaths(tempdir())
install.packages("isoband", type = "binary")
update.packages(lib.loc = tempdir(), ask = FALSE)
```

I see:

```
> .libPaths(tempdir())
> install.packages("isoband", type = "binary")
Installing package into 'C:/Users/kevinushey/AppData/Local/Temp/RtmpUFeV9y'
(as 'lib' is unspecified)

  There is a binary version available (and will be installed) but the source version is later:
        binary source
isoband  0.2.4  0.2.5

trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/contrib/4.1/isoband_0.2.4.zip'
 length 3062211 bytes (2.9 MB)
downloaded 2.9 MB

package 'isoband' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked

The downloaded binary packages are in
	C:\Users\kevinushey\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpUFeV9y\downloaded_packages
> update.packages(lib.loc = tempdir(), ask = FALSE)

  There is a binary version available but the source version is later:
        binary source needs_compilation
isoband  0.2.4  0.2.5              TRUE

  Binaries will be installed
trying URL 'https://cran.rstudio.com/bin/windows/contrib/4.1/isoband_0.2.4.zip'
 length 3062211 bytes (2.9 MB)
downloaded 2.9 MB

package 'isoband' successfully unpacked and MD5 sums checked

The downloaded binary packages are in
	C:\Users\kevinushey\AppData\Local\Temp\RtmpUFeV9y\downloaded_packages
```
